name: strait
description: When the space available is small, Strait becomes very useful. A great quality condensed typeface that is suitable for both display and text usage, and with excellent reading performance at 12 point size. The February 2023 update features a bigger glyphset, fractions and some minor aesthetic modifications. To contribute, see github.com/etunni/Strait .
